content: The water that carves through the canyon does so not through fury, but through unceasing persistence.
author: Chinese Proverbs
sourceWork: Di shui chuan shi (滴水穿石) — Classical Chengyu
explanation: A single drop of water has zero impact against a granite boulder. Yet when drop after drop strikes the exact same fissure year after year, the mountain is split asunder. Never underestimate the omnipotent power of gentle, repetitive devotion.
practicalInsight: Show up for your practice today, even if you feel tired. A single drop of effort added to yesterday's drops will eventually split the stone.
reflectionPrompt: What difficult barrier in your life requires patient, repetitive persistence rather than a frantic emotional explosion?
